conclusions.basis: Reverse finite-DAG value and forward candidate-own occupancy use equal initial world mass. The derivative is dJ/dscore=d(s)*pi(a|s)*(Q-V)/tau; Belief chain factor 2*p*(1-p)*(coef_submit1-coef_submit0) and L2 regularizer derivative are consistent. Q and Belief rows map to the same four readout outputs.
conclusions.limits: A mathematical review on the smooth interior of the clipping function, not a new finite-difference experiment or a proof of binary64 differentiation at clamp boundaries.

conclusions.basis: Both families have 128 proposals plus one initial complete objective. DIRECT uses 8 rounds*8 states*2 doses and no weight derivative; BP uses128 steps and129 derivative evaluations. Attempt counters increment before numerical work; failed family returns KEEP; process supervisor captures imports, final serialization and process-exit CPU. The family_objective_call_limit field is not separately consulted, but the frozen loop bounds and slot count enforce129 calls for this exact protocol.
conclusions.limits: Forward-row/DP counters count attempted calls, even when arithmetic would fail. They should not be described as completed work on a failing run. Source authoring/static-review tool CPU is not instrumented by the scientific supervisor.
